name: Harissa Tikka Roast Chicken
description: A whole halal chicken dry-brined, then coated in a yogurt, tikka spice, and rose harissa marinade and roasted French poulet rôti style for crackling skin and deeply spiced, juicy meat.
keywords: harissa tikka roast chicken, halal roast chicken recipe, french pakistani fusion chicken, tikka roast chicken, poulet roti, rose harissa chicken
recipeIngredient: 1.5 tsp fine sea salt for dry salting
4 garlic cloves, grated to a paste

recipeInstructions.name: Dry-salt the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels inside and out. Sprinkle 1.5 tsp fine salt over the outside and cavity. Place on a wire rack over a tray and refrigerate uncovered for 8–24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the tikka harissa marinade
recipeInstructions.text: Combine yogurt, rose harissa, garlic paste, ginger, Kashmiri chilli, cumin, coriander, garam masala, smoked paprika, turmeric, hing, 1.5 tsp salt, oil, and lemon juice. Whisk until smooth and taste for seasoning.

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Rub the marinade firmly over the entire chicken, including inside the cavity and under the neck flap. Return to the rack, uncovered, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours and up to 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Bring to room temperature
recipeInstructions.text: Remove the chicken from the refrigerator 45 minutes before roasting.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat oven and prepare the tin
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Arrange halved onion, lemon, and unpeeled garlic cloves in a roasting tin to act as a trivet.

recipeInstructions.name: Butter and position the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Smear softened butter over the breast and legs. Set the chicken breast-side up on the trivet in the roasting tin.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast at high heat
recipeInstructions.text: Roast at 220°C for 45 minutes without opening the oven or basting.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish roasting
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce temperature to 190°C (375°F) and roast for a further 20–25 minutes until a probe thermometer reads 74°C (165°F) in the thickest part of the thigh.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer to a warm plate and rest for 15 minutes before carving.

recipeInstructions.name: Make a quick pan sauce and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze roasted lemon over the tin juices, press out the roasted garlic, and stir together. Spoon over carved chicken. Finish with flaky salt.
